summary: The agent sets up a reasonably sophisticated ordinal classification pipeline using cumulative probabilities and threshold tuning. However, the solution contains a critical flaw where it discards the original test IDs and replaces them with a sequential range, breaking the submission format entirely. Furthermore, it leaks validation set statistics by imputing missing values before splitting, fails to report any evaluation metrics, and skips feature engineering.
